subject: english
question:
Choose the correct meaning of the idiom:

Carry coals to Newcastle

options.text: Supply something where it already exists in excess

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **Supply something where it already exists in excess**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Carry coals to Newcastle"** means to do something that is redundant or unnecessary because the thing being supplied is already in abundance. (जहां पहले से ही अधिकता हो वहां कुछ और आपूर्ति करना)

 
 
• **Example:** Suggesting more rainwater harvesting methods in a town that already has overflowing reservoirs is like carrying coals to Newcastle.
 

 
• **Newcastle** was historically known for its coal mines, making it unnecessary to bring coal there. Hence, the phrase symbolizes a futile or redundant effort. (न्यूकैसल अपने कोयला खानों के लिए जाना जाता था, इसलिए वहां कोयला ले जाना व्यर्थ का प्रयास है।)

 
 
• **Example:** Bringing sand to a desert is just another way of carrying coals to Newcastle.
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 2: Ask advice from specialists** (विशेषज्ञों से सलाह लेना): Seeking guidance or expertise from someone knowledgeable in a specific field.

 
 
• **Example:** Before starting her business, she decided to ask advice from specialists in the field.
 
 

 
• **Option 3: Complain unnecessarily** (अनावश्यक शिकायत करना): To grumble or object without a valid reason.

 
 
• **Example:** He keeps complaining unnecessarily about things that don’t matter.
 
 

 
• **Option 4: Travel aimlessly** (बिना उद्देश्य के यात्रा करना): To wander without a particular goal or destination.

 
 
• **Example:** After losing his job, he started traveling aimlessly around the country.
